# Client Request: Claims Portal, full series (synthetic fixture)

This is a synthetic fixture for the release-series flow with every release type; no real client is behind it.

We want a claims portal for our policyholders and our back office. The goal is to cut the time a claim takes from filing to payment.

The main users are policyholders, who file and follow their claims, and back office adjusters, who review and approve them.

In scope: online claim filing with attachments. In scope: claim review and approval by back office adjusters. In scope: claim status tracking for policyholders. In scope: payment of approved claims through the payment provider. In scope: one claims workspace where adjusters work every claim. Out of scope: fraud scoring and agent commissions.

We expect online filing to reach 60 percent of all claims within two quarters.

The payment provider contract is still being negotiated, and nobody has measured yet how long the attachment scan takes.
